Action.GunnerOverchargedDesc: Full heavy fire. Spend {{SHIPCOMBAT.Term.AllocationUnits}} to inflict Critical Effects on enemy subsystems.

Gunner.OrdnanceSLTooltip: Roll Gunnery to generate {{SHIPCOMBAT.Term.AllocationUnits}} for Accuracy, Penetration, and Firepower allocation.
Gunner.RangingFireDesc: Fires half a salvo at {{SHIPCOMBAT.ModifierCopy.HitPenalty}} to hit. If any shot connects, it brackets the target – granting {{SHIPCOMBAT.ModifierCopy.HitBonus}} to hit against that ship with ALL weapon batteries for the rest of the round.

Helm.EvasionTooltip: Each {{SHIPCOMBAT.Term.AllocationUnit}} allocated increases your ship's AC by 1 this round.
Helm.PilotingSLTooltip: Roll Piloting to generate {{SHIPCOMBAT.Term.AllocationUnits}} for Speed, Maneuverability, and Evasion allocation.
Helm.EngineeringSLTooltip: Roll Engineering to generate {{SHIPCOMBAT.Term.AllocationUnits}} for Speed, Maneuverability, and Evasion allocation.

Engineer.EngineeringSLTooltip: Roll Engineering to generate {{SHIPCOMBAT.Term.AllocationUnits}} for Speed, Maneuverability, and Evasion allocation.
Engineer.ManageHeatDesc: Spend auxiliary power and roll Engineering to perform cooling procedures. Reduce heat by power spent + {{SHIPCOMBAT.Term.AllocationUnits}} (minimum 1).
Engineer.SuppressFireDesc: Spend auxiliary power and roll Engineering to suppress fire. Reduce fire by power spent + {{SHIPCOMBAT.Term.AllocationUnits}} (minimum 1).
Engineer.HullRepairDesc: Spend auxiliary power and roll Engineering to restore hull integrity. Costs +1 heat. Hull restored = power spent + {{SHIPCOMBAT.Term.AllocationUnits}}. Cannot repair during internal fire.
Engineer.PlasmaForRepairHint: Spend up to {max} auxiliary power. Each unit restores 1 hull plus the allocated {{SHIPCOMBAT.Term.AllocationUnits}}.

Ordnance.RequisitionDesc: Roll Athletics to generate Ordnance {{SHIPCOMBAT.Term.AllocationUnits}} for Efficiency and Expedience allocation.
Ordnance.EfficiencyTooltip: Reduce crew cost by 1 per {{SHIPCOMBAT.Term.AllocationUnit}} allocated (minimum 2 crew per action).
Ordnance.ExpedienceTooltip: Reduce action duration by 1 turn per {{SHIPCOMBAT.Term.AllocationUnit}} allocated (minimum 1 turn).

Captain.LeadershipSLTooltip: Roll Leadership to generate {{SHIPCOMBAT.Term.AllocationUnits}} for Inspire, Resolve, and Initiative allocation.
Captain.InspireTooltip: +1 to next round's starting hand limit per {{SHIPCOMBAT.Term.AllocationUnit}} allocated, above the base limit of 3. The bonus does not stack across rounds.
Captain.InitiativeTooltip: Allocate {{SHIPCOMBAT.Term.AllocationUnits}} to boost the next round's combat initiative by 1 per {{SHIPCOMBAT.Term.AllocationUnit}}.

Desc.repairArmour: Fully restore rend damage on one sector, resetting its effective hardness to maximum.

Core.BCPrompt: Choose an enemy to designate as the priority target. All weapons fired at this target gain {{SHIPCOMBAT.ModifierCopy.HitBonus}} accuracy, 2 hardness penetration, and 2 shield burn this round.
Core.RAPrompt: Choose which sector to fully restore rend hardness damage.

Component.HitRatingModifierDesc: Applies a flat bonus or penalty to the hit roll for all shots from this battery.
Component.OverclockBaseDCHint: Base DC for overclock checks at minimum heat. Scales up by 10 at maximum reactor heat.

Tooltip.OverclockDC: Overclock the reactor: DC {dc} {skill} check, +1 Heat
Tooltip.Classification: The ship's class or type designation
Tooltip.Model: The manufacturer's model designation for this vessel
Tooltip.Crew: Minimum number of crew members required to operate this ship
Tooltip.Passengers: Maximum number of passengers this ship can carry
Tooltip.Price: The purchase price of this ship

Sensors.FocusedScanDesc: Free action (once per turn). Roll Sensors; gain Sensor base rate + positive {{SHIPCOMBAT.Term.AllocationUnits}} as Power.
Sensors.DeepScanDesc: Upgrade to Lock 3. Reveals hardness, shield values, hull, AC, and weapon fire arcs per sector. Shows actual ship name.
Sensors.TargetingSolutionDesc: Upgrade to Lock 4. Reveals conditions and defenses (immunities, weaknesses, resistances). Gunner gets {{SHIPCOMBAT.ModifierCopy.HitBonus}} to accuracy against this target.
Sensors.SensorDisruptionDesc: Requires Lock 1. Designate one locked enemy. It suffers a penalty to all rolls (including weapon accuracy) equal to your sensors' Hit Modifier, minimum -1, for 1 round.

BDA.RollTooltip: Roll Sensors to assess battle damage. The number of {{SHIPCOMBAT.Term.AllocationUnits}} determines how much lock is retained.
BDA.AdjustBearingDesc: {{SHIPCOMBAT.ModifierCopy.HitBonus}} to hit on the next attack with this weapon at this target.
BDA.TargetWeakPointDesc: Add the allocated {{SHIPCOMBAT.Term.AllocationUnits}} to hardness penetration on the next attack.
BDA.FireForEffectDesc: Each {{SHIPCOMBAT.Term.AllocationUnit}} reduces the critical hit threshold by 1 (base crit requires exceeding AC by 10; stacks with the Devastating weapon trait).

Payload.APShellsDesc: +2 hardness penetration on all macro cannon attacks this round.

Trait.RendDesc: Each hit that gets through shields permanently reduces sector hardness by this value - even if hardness absorbs all resulting hull damage. The hardness reduction still occurs regardless of whether hull damage is dealt.
Trait.ArmourPenetrationDesc: Reduces the target sector's effective hardness by this value when calculating damage per hit.
Trait.DevastatingDesc: Lowers the critical-hit margin by this value (base: crit on exceeding AC by 10, so Devastating 2 crits at AC+8). Each critting shot also deals bonus damage equal to this value, still reduced by the target's hardness.
Trait.UnreliableDesc: On a critical failure — the shot misses by 10 or more after nat-20/nat-1 degree adjustments — the shot jams and the entire salvo is lost. A natural 1 that is promoted to a miss (e.g. nat-1 on a hit) does not trigger a jam.
